title: Fix a Flaky Test with AI: Why It Passes, Then Fails
description:
This test passes, then fails. Here's the fix! 🎯

✅ Run a test 20 times to expose a flaky failure
✅ Ask AI what is random in the test
✅ Pin the seed so every run gives the same result

Day 7 of AI Debugging. Next up: Day 8, Debug a Failing CI Run from Logs.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to debug with AI the right way.

#shorts #coding #programming #ai #python #pytest #softwaretesting
comment: Seed or mock: which would you try first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: to repeat a test 20 times, install the pytest-repeat plugin, then run pytest --count=20. One failure means it is flaky.
